Please apply through the link above; we don't accept applications by email.

Thankly | Founding Engineer, Founding Engineer (RL Environments), Founding Product Designer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | Equity-first

Thankly builds branded shopping apps that run inside AI assistants, including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Shoppers ask for what they need in conversation, the app recommends products from the brand's own catalog, and they can check out without leaving the chat.

Founding Engineer: Build our platform and client apps on React, Vite, Express, TypeScript, Supabase and Postgres, working from technical designs written by our CTO. Founding Product Designer: Own the UX of the apps we build for clients and of our own platform, and set the patterns for how shopping works inside AI conversations. 3+ years of full-time product design experience and a portfolio. https://thankly.ai/careers/product-designer

These are equity-first founding roles. At least 4 hours a day of overlap with Eastern Time.

To apply, email harsh@thankly.ai with your GitHub or portfolio and one sentence about the best thing you've built.

comment_text.value:
Estuary | US-Based / Remote | Full-time – https://estuary.dev/

Estuary is a VC-backed, post–Series A startup powering real-time data replication and transform — from sub-second CDC replication to terabyte-scale OLAP data flows. We’re open-source, developer-first, and focused on making data movement radically simpler across both our Platform and Applications layers.

We’re hiring for:

Head of Engineering — Own the engineering function end-to-end as a partner to our founder CTO: strategy, people, delivery, and operations across a compact but high-leverage team. You’ll grow the leaders already running our teams, set technical strategy jointly with the CTO, and be accountable for what engineering ships and what it costs.

Senior Systems Engineer (Control & Data Plane) — Build the high-performance backbone of our platform: the orchestration, distributed state, and stream transport that keep pipelines at sub-second latency under massive throughput. You’ll work primarily in Rust on fault tolerance, consensus, and networking, and help set the bar for correctness and performance across the team.

Product Manager — Own product areas end-to-end, working closely with engineering and design to shape the roadmap and deliver a great developer experience. Engage with users, translate real-world use cases into product decisions, and help define how modern data infrastructure should feel to build with.

Head of Product Marketing — Lead product marketing as we bring real-time, agent-ready data pipelines to technical buyers, partnering closely with our Head of Marketing, Developer Relations, and the founders. Own positioning, messaging, launches, and competitive narrative, turning what our engineers ship into stories data teams actually care about.

Solutions Engineer — Partner with sales and customers from the first technical call through production, running discovery, demos, and proofs of concept for data engineering and platform teams. You’ll design CDC, streaming, and batch pipelines on Estuary, solve real integration problems hands-on, and feed what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

Customer Success Manager — Own the post-sale relationship for our data engineering and platform customers as our first CS hire. You’ll build onboarding, account health monitoring, and the expansion playbook from scratch while staying technical enough to resolve most issues yourself.

Senior Compliance Engineer — Own our GDPR and PCI DSS programs while keeping our audited SOC 2 and HIPAA programs running smoothly, alongside hands-on ownership of identity, endpoint, and SaaS estate management. This is a governance-first role for someone who has run a compliance program end-to-end, not just contributed to one.

What we’re looking for: People who care about building reliable, maintainable systems and processes and enjoy working with complex APIs, data flows, or customer relationships. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a willingness to learn.

Bonus points for experience with CDC tools, open source contributions, or fast-paced startups.

To apply: Email your resume to careers@estuary.dev

Exponent | Lead Engineer, AI Accounting | New York (Flatiron) | HYBRID, 2+ days in office | $160k–$200k + equity | Full-time

Exponent is a financial platform for franchise and multi-location restaurant operators: charge cards, loans, and an AI-powered Accountant that pulls in an operator's POS, bank, payroll and processor data, reconciles it, and automates the monthly close.

You'd own core systems in the Accountant: idempotent ingestion from unreliable third-party APIs, the background jobs that keep thousands of accounts in sync, and the decisions about how LLM classification behaves inside a ledger that has to be right. Full stack, focused on backend architecture. Rails, Postgres, Sidekiq. We ship multiple times a day.

We want someone who ships fast and knows when to slow down. 5+ years, deep experience in any server-side framework (Rails, Django, Phoenix, TypeScript), and fluent with AI-assisted development. Fintech and Rails experience are strong pluses.

Email careers@exponentfi.com with a short note on why this interests you.

ThreatMark | Security, Machine Learning | REMOTE(World) / Brno, Czech Republic | Equity

ThreatMark protects >60M end users from finacial fraud and saves > $1.2M every day in losses.

We are working with banks in EU and US to protect their end users.

We develop large-behavioral models that recognizes returning users by their mouse movements, keystroke timings and sensoric data (accelerometer, gyroscope).

We detect cyberthreats (e.g. malware, phishing, scraping) by exploiting browsers/sandboxes of devices.

We manage ~PB scale of data and provide realtime scoring in milliseconds driving authentication/authorization flow (2nd factor).

Stack: [python, typescript, rust], [redis, postgresql], [aws, terraform] ...

We are looking for exceptional engineers to build with us and be part of the success:

- Backend Engineer [rust, python] - low-latency stream processing engine, rewrite python microservices to rust, build new detection features

- DevOps Engineer (IaaC in AWS)

- DevSecOps Engineer

- AI Tech Lead (loops & graphs guru, real ML background)

- Security Researcher/Engineer

- Product Manager [USA]

- Fraud Detection Specialist

- Partner Manager

If you are interested, please email us @ career@threatmark.com with subject "HN Who's Hiring"

If you don't find the right role here or at https://www.threatmark.com/careers/, write us anyway if you believe you can be good fit :)

Krystof Hilar, Co-Founder & CTO

I’m Marcelus Brice, founder of TheraPlug (https://theraplug.health). We’re building a behavioral health platform focused on making it easier for patients to find appropriate therapists and access care through insurance, starting in Detroit.

We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader who can build alongside a lean team and help recruit its founding engineers. You don’t need a previous CTO title, but you should have shipped and operated production software.

The product will support iOS, Android and responsive web, including:

• Patient and provider onboarding, scheduling and secure messaging. • AI-assisted therapist matching based on clinical needs, preferences, insurance and availability. • Provider credential verification and payer enrollment workflows. • Insurance eligibility checks and estimated patient costs. • Secure video sessions and clinician-reviewed AI documentation.

Relevant experience includes full-stack development, mobile apps, healthcare integrations, sensitive-data security and practical AI implementation. We value clear architecture, accessible design and thoughtful use of established services.

Compensation: We are pre-funding and cannot offer an immediate cash salary. We’re seeking someone interested in an equity-first founding role, with a planned transition to salary when funding supports payroll. Equity, responsibilities, time commitment and compensation triggers would be agreed in writing before work begins. Funding timing is not guaranteed.

To start a conversation, email marcelus@theraplug.health with: • Products you’ve built and your specific contribution. • Relevant healthcare, security or AI experience. • Your location and realistic availability before funding. • Your interest in leading and assembling a small development team.

I can share the detailed product scope and team requirements.

IMC Trading | Machine Learning Engineer | Amsterdam OR London | ONSITE | Full-time

IMC is a research-driven trading firm and has been a market maker since 1989. Our researchers, traders and engineers work as one team on systems we build ourselves, trading across global markets.

We want ML engineers to shorten the path from a research idea to a live trading strategy. You’ll work with quant researchers, HPC specialists and software engineers in one of two overlapping areas:

- ML research engineering: distributed training pipelines, experiment automation, and making training faster and cheaper to run at scale. - ML performance engineering: low-latency, real-time inference, and getting the most out of GPUs.

Stack includes: PyTorch, CUDA

We’re looking for 3+ years of hands-on ML systems work and production Python code you’ve owned over time. You should understand what happens beneath the high-level APIs and measure performance before you optimize. Depth in distributed training, GPU optimization, real-time inference or numerics at scale is a big plus.

Apply: https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4567047101

NB - visa sponsorship available

AREO | Remote (EU) and On-Site in Bremen, Germany | Full-Time | Equity | Roles: Engineering Manager (Ruby on Rails), Robotics Engineer

My name is Marius, and I am the CTO at AREO (https://goareo.com/)

AREO, founded in January 2023 by a team with 20+ years of combined experience in retail and startups, is a young startup specializing in developing innovative solutions for supermarkets and grocery stores.

Our B2B SaaS platform optimizes employee workflows by providing real-time access to inventory, product information, and customer inquiries. We serve large supermarket chains in Germany and across the EU.

We have already hired two backend developers through "HN - Who is hiring?" and are now seeking an Engineering Manager (Ruby on Rails) with at least 8 years of experience (preferably in startups). We recently signed another large contract with a major retail chain, are growing quickly, and expect to close a pre-seed funding round in the next few days.

For the Engineering Manager role, professional proficiency in German is required, and you must be based in the EU.

Backend Stack: Ruby / Rails (8.x), StimulusJS / Hotwire / Turbo, AlpineJS, Postgres, Docker, DigitalOcean, OpenAPI, LLMs

We are also seeking a Robotics Engineer to work from our robotics lab in Bremen, Germany. We are building a retail robot, initially focusing on teleoperation and later on developing autonomous models. You should have at least 2 years of experience with humanoid robots, VLAs, teleoperation, and other relevant robotics systems. Professional proficiency in German is required, and you must live in Bremen or be willing to relocate.

Perks: Fully remote setup within Europe for the Engineering Manager, sizeable equity in a rapidly growing company, flat hierarchies, a no-ego work environment, and the opportunity to work in a lean but highly experienced team.

Apply here: marius[at]goareo.com and mention "HN - Who is hiring?" and the role you're applying for in the subject line.

Marker Learning | Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend-Leaning) | Full-time | Remote, US only | $180k–$200k | https://www.markerlearning.com

We’re building the Marker Method, a digital assessment platform that helps clinicians understand how students learn. It brings together interactive assessments, automated scoring, and tools for interpreting results. Our norming study is underway, and we’re building toward launch.

We’re looking for a frontend-leaning full-stack engineer to join our small engineering team. You’ll build student-facing assessment experiences and clinician tools, with ownership across the frontend and the systems behind it.

Strong TypeScript, React, and Next.js experience is especially relevant. We care about product judgment, thoughtful UI, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to working software. You should be comfortable working independently, making sensible technical decisions, and writing code every day.

If you enjoy getting the details right on software that students and clinicians actually use, we’d love to talk.

Apply: [careers@markerlearning.com] with a résumé or LinkedIn profile and a little about something you’ve built.

Proofline | Founding Staff / Principal Engineer | REMOTE (Worldwide, Berlin timezone overlap preferred) | Full-time | €120k-€200k + equity | https://proofline.sh/careers/founding-staff-principal-engine...

Hi HN, I'm the founder of Proofline. We're building an infrastructure-aware AI code reviewer that catches deployment failures before they reach production. Think of it as a type checker for your cloud infrastructure. We analyze code changes against Terraform, live cloud environments, and deployment evidence rather than just reading diffs.

We're hiring a hands-on Staff / Principal Engineer to help us build. You'll own core SaaS architecture, cloud integrations, developer tools, and product delivery, with a path toward engineering leadership.

Stack: Rust, Go, PostgreSQL, React/TypeScript, Terraform, AWS, GCP.

We're looking for someone with 10+ years of hands-on infrastructure engineering experience, deep SaaS and cloud expertise, extensive use of AI coding agents, and a track record of shipping end to end.

Remote globally, flexible hours, regular Berlin visits required. Salary: €120k-€200k depending on experience and location, plus meaningful founding equity. No visa sponsorship.

To apply, ship a small feature PR to one of our open-source developer tools and email careers@proofline.sh with the link. If you have 10+ years of relevant experience and an established online presence showcasing your technical work, you can skip the PR and share your best work with us instead.

Details: https://proofline.sh/careers/founding-staff-principal-engine...

comment_text.value:
Blockrotate| Senior Systems / Rust Engineer | Remote (US/EU timezones preferred) | Full-time | $130k - $170k + Equity

Blockrotate (https://blockrotate.com) builds low-latency copy-trading and execution infrastructure for Polymarket and prediction markets.

Copy trading on prediction markets has strange market microstructure. Unlike deep perp DEXes (Binance, Hyperliquid), Polymarket orderbooks are bounded, often thin, and subject to severe adverse selection. When a high-volume leader buys, the book moves immediately. If followers lag by a few hundred milliseconds, or if a platform taxes every order with a 50bps fee, follower alpha drops to zero.

Most existing tools in this space either hit users with high per-trade taker fees or ask them to export and paste their master private key into a database. We took a different approach: isolated per-bot deposit wallets (non-custodial via EIP-1967/1271 proxies) and co-located autonomous Rust workers running delta-sync loops directly against the Polymarket CLOB.

Stack:

- Backend: Rust, Tokio, Axum, Protobuf over WebSockets, SQLite (WAL mode)

- Trading Engine: Custom Polymarket CLOB & Data API clients, EIP-712 signing, dynamic slippage ladders, momentum filters, circuit breakers

- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

What you’d actually work on:

- Squeezing latency out of the execution hot path (delta position calculation, order placement, nonce handling, fill verification).

- Building better execution protection: momentum filters to dodge toxic order flow, fill stabilization windows, and handling thin book liquidity without moving the market against yourself.

- Scaling worker orchestration: our C2 server talks Protobuf to distributed bot workers with monotonic sequence IDs and autonomous reconnect failover. As bot volume scales, we need to keep state reconciliation bulletproof.

- Investigating and exploiting prediction market quirks (rebate structures, orderbook snapshotting, MEV/relayer bottlenecks).

What we look for:

- Strong async Rust experience (Tokio, concurrency, practical memory management).

- Experience dealing with websockets, exchange orderbooks, or trading infrastructure

shoot an email to jobs@blockrotate.com and tell us why you would be a good fit for us.

Splash Tech | DevOps Mid/Senior | Remote (LATAM and EU) | Full Time | https://splash.tech/

We're a small UK-based free-to-play gaming company with a distributed team, growing fast after recent success and scaling our backend platform. We’re looking for a DevOps engineer with 5+ years of experience.

Most of the work is AWS-focused. You should have hands-on experience with:

- AWS, particularly EKS, EC2, Application Load Balancers, RDS, and IAM. - Terraform and managing infrastructure as code. - Kubernetes, including troubleshooting workloads and cluster issues. - CI/CD and GitOps workflows using GitHub Actions and Flux. - Monitoring, alerting, and tracing with tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Jaeger, and OpenTelemetry. - DNS, TLS, and Cloudflare.

Strong AWS networking knowledge, including VPC design, routing, private connectivity, and troubleshooting is highly desirable.

Our stack includes AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), PostgreSQL, Trino, Flux, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. You don’t need to know every tool already, but you should be comfortable learning what the job requires.

You should be comfortable owning work from identifying a problem and proposing a solution through implementation, rollout, documentation, and ongoing operation.

You should be comfortable investigating issues across applications, Kubernetes, networking, and databases. We also value clear thinking and communication: you should be able to explain your ideas and trade-offs using simple architecture or flow diagrams—just boxes and lines, nothing formal.

To apply, email lucas[at]splash.tech with the subject “DevOps Engineer 2026”. Include a brief introduction and a link to a repository or project that demonstrates your infrastructure or automation work. If you don’t have work you can share, we may ask you to complete a small practical test.

comment_text.value:
I'm modeling ourselves after Valve, which strongly emphasizes on-site. Valve gives its folks tons of latitude and freedom in exchange for working together in a tightly-knit culture.

I'm not a stickler for showing up to work on time, and I'm a late riser / night owl myself. But the energy of being in a room together physically is extremely hard to beat.

I'm not doing this to micro-manage. I don't have time for that. I'm doing this to be a better version of myself. I get energy from working close to others, and I voraciously learn from my peers. I want people teaching me and helping me be better every single day. That might be selfish, but I thrive in that environment.

What we're doing is weird and experimental and there's a metric ton of discovery in literally every path we take. A culture built around documenting and reading notes isn't going to be fast enough. I'm more hands on than someone who can write 6-pagers and read everyone else's - like Shia LaBeouf's "just do it" energy.

I understand that this isn't a great fit for everyone, and I'm sorry.

I'm not allergic to remote once we're bigger, but we have an enormous mandate, and I want us to tackle it like an RPG final boss in the trenches together. We have a lot to build and prove and learn. Doing it together in person reduces the network hop effects and leads to more serendipity and exchange.

In a years' time, I want us to have built open source alternatives to large portions of the most used software. I want us to create a considerable shake up. I want us to have built new infrastructure to make the web more distributed and more P2P.

I think we stand a better chance if we're in a room together, hacking and engineering together. That's what my gut tells me.

I make films too, and that's frankly something that could never be fully remote.

At FusionAuth, our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer building web and mobile applications. We want devs to stop worrying about auth and focus on building something awesome.

There are a lot of companies in the auth space, but we feel like we have something special:

* a relatively unique deployment model (self-host on-prem, run in your cloud or let us operate it for you in ours)

* A well designed API first approach; one customer compared our APIs to petrichor

* a mature product (the code base is nine+ years old and we've found and fixed a lot of the sharp edges around core login use cases, but don't worry, there are plenty more features to add)

* a full featured free-as-in-beer version which makes the sales cycle easier; prospects often come in having prototyped an integration

Our core software is commercial. We open source much of our supporting infrastructure. Technologies and standards that you will work with: modern Java, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, MySQL, OAuth, SAML, OIDC.

Learn more, including benefits and salaries, and apply here: https://fusionauth.io/careers/ ( Click/tap the 'View open positions' orange button. )

Quantum Rise | Chicago IL or Remote (US, Brazil or EU) | Full-time | No visa sponsorship | https://www.quantumrise.com/

Quantum Rise is an AI-forward consulting startup serving the mid-market in the US and larger enterprises in LATAM. We see companies in multiple industries struggling to understand how to leverage artificial intelligence in their day-to-day operations, trying to understand what their existing workforce now needs to know, or trying to understand whether they're about to be disrupted and need to change how their existing processes work. Many have business problems which "traditional" machine learning could help with even prior to the current GenAI hype cycle, but for whatever reason hadn't prioritized doing until now. Kanurra | Founding Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K to $310K + equity | https://www.kanurra.com/careers/founding-engineer

Every prescription filled on a health plan gets priced and paid at the pharmacy counter in seconds, passing through four or five companies, and the employer paying for it almost never sees what it cost. We're building the platform those claims are priced, paid and audited on, in the open. TPAs and brokers build on it.

I'm the founder and an engineer, and I've written most of what exists. Hiring engineer #1. The problems: paying the same claim exactly once across reversals, rebills and retries; a versioned API that outside companies build their business on; isolating each customer's health data, enforced in Postgres; and drug prices that change retroactively but still have to be explainable. Stack: Python, TypeScript, Postgres, GCP. No healthcare experience needed.

Email me at hello@kanurra.com with something you built and the one thing in it you'd never let change.

Don't Use This Code: https://dutc.io | Training & Consulting | Full-Time (W-2) | Fully Remote (US-only)

Don't Use This Code's mission statement grew out of a joke… let's look at something amazing that will change the way you think about this programming language feature or this open source library… just DON'T USE THIS CODE.

I (the poster of this) made a little of a name for myself in the Python community through this very approach. See: https://pyvideo.org/speaker/james-powell.html or https://www.youtube.com/@dutctv or https://www.youtube.com/@PyDataTV/search?query=james%20powel...

The core principle is: true expertise and expert knowledge is worthwhile to develop and disseminate (and this is true even if the LLM is doing a lot of the typing.) To this end, our goal is to deliver a combination of training, consulting, and hybrid coaching services to clients in the tech industry, in financial services, and at large-scale scientific research facilities. In fact, on the back of some recent successes, we are gearing up to build up a team and dramatically expand this work. Our work involves a lot of data analysis, data visualization, modelling, simulation, and experiment tooling system and infrastructure, and is currently very Python and PyData heavy.

We are looking to hire both junior and senior technical leads, as well as instructors.

We're just beginning to ramp up our hiring process, but provisional job reqs are available:

- Senior Tech Lead: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_uJdBJlGmin4gQ_9kxxFS7cH...

- Junior Tech Lead: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_uJdBJlGmin4gQ_9kxxFS7cH...

- Instructor: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_uJdBJlGmin4gQ_9kxxFS7cH...

Given the nature of our clients, we are especially fond of hiring people with background in the sciences, including those in fields like biology or psychology, who have a strong (perhaps even self-taught) technical background.

E-mail with your résumé or LinkedIn and add any thoughts you have on developing and sharing expert knowledge: jobs@dutc.io

comment_text.value:
Subimage (YC W25) | Founding Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE (5 days/week) | Full-time | $170K–$230K + 0.5%–1.0% equity | https://subimage.io

Hihi, I'm Alex, co-founder and CEO. Subimage maps infrastructure the way an attacker does so security teams at scale-ups and enterprises can find and fix problems. We're built on Cartography (https://cartography.dev), the open source infra mapping tool we helped create at Lyft and donated to the CNCF. It runs at over 70 companies, including 7 in the Fortune 100.

We're a tiny seed-stage team and our customers are companies your parents have heard of. We have more demand than we can build for, which is why this post exists. This is a chance to get in on the ground floor of something big (or to find out quickly that it won't work; just being upfront about it).

Some of the problems you'd be working on:

- Vulnerability triage with real context: is the asset internet-facing, through which services, is the vulnerable function actually reachable in code, are there compensating controls, and what sensitive data does it reach once exploited, across how many hops.

- Proving that the security fixes our agent proposes won't break anything.

- A near-real-time, self-updating map of an environment so you can see an attack as it happens, plus "time travel" in the graph so you can replay it afterward.

- Teaching an agent to answer questions about a large graph quickly, with only the context it needs and without making mistakes.

- Determining who owns a given resource from messy signals like tags, actions, logs, and files.

Stack: Cartography for ingestion, Neo4j for the graph, Python/FastAPI backend, Svelte frontend with a homegrown WebGL graph renderer, an MCP server that exposes all of it to agents, Terraform for IaC.

Who we're looking for: 3+ years at high-growth companies, strong distributed systems and cloud experience, a real sense of ownership, first-principles thinking, and a willingness to implement gnarly business logic (elegantly, ideally) if it makes a jaded security engineer's life easier. Kubernetes and security knowledge are nice to have, not required. You're in the Bay Area and want to be in the office five days a week.

Process: technical screen, call with the founders, a paid day working with the team, then offer. Health/vision/dental, 401k match, gym, team lunches, unlimited PTO.

Apply here and mention HN: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/subimage/jobs/NCTFgKK-...

Middesk | Full-time | SF / NYC | Hybrid | https://www.middesk.com/

Middesk helps companies figure out who’s actually behind a business. Banks, fintechs, and platforms rely on us to get that answer fast and accurate before they issue a card, fund a merchant, or open an account.

We pull data from hundreds of government agencies, resolve it into a single view of a business, and serve it through an API. Business verification is becoming core infrastructure connecting businesses, banks, and governments, and that’s what we’re building. And our engineers build with AI every day. Earlier this year, agents helped us refactor our entire data pipeline.

Middesk is a Series B company backed by Sequoia and Accel, came out of YC, and was recently named to Forbes’ Fintech 50. We’re looking for folks who like getting close to customers and turning that context into product decisions.

Curiosity (https://curiosity.ai) | Forward Deployed Engineer, DevOps Architect | Toulouse, France | ONSITE | Full-time (CDI) | Visa support

Curiosity Studio builds internal apps and agents from a plain description, on a company's connected data and inside its permissions. It runs on premises or in a private cloud, with any LLM. We're bootstrapped, profitable and based in Munich. Our customers are large industrial and regulated companies, Airbus among them, and Studio has 30TB+ of data connected in production.

We are starting a team in Toulouse that works at customer sites, in French and English, along with the engineers who build Studio.

Forward Deployed Engineer: take a customer's problem from the first workshop to production. You decide with them what Studio should build, connect their systems, model the data as a graph, and oversee the C#/.NET connectors and services it needs. You also ship features and agents on top.

DevOps Architect: Own deployments in customer environments, from the first technical discussion to handover, on private clouds or data centers. Networking, IAM, Linux, Docker, monitoring, backups, upgrades, incidents. You also write code alongside the forward deployed engineers.

We're looking for hands-on builders who enjoy working directly with customers. Full-stack project experience preferred. Fluent French and English required.

Interviews: a 30 minute call, a technical conversation, then the founders.

CV to jobs@curiosity.ai, mention Hacker News. Details: https://curiosity.ai/careers/

Blackbird | Dev Shop | Remote (US only) | Contract

Blackbird builds web, mobile, IoT products for startups and innovative companies. We work on interesting, greenfield projects, and rely on small, veteran teams who have lots of autonomy. Everyone is a remote contractor, and our work culture is low-drama and highly collaborative. No pointless meetings, no bureaucracy, no egos and lots of time spent building things. Projects typically range from 3-12 months and usually require full time hours (35/week).

We’re looking for senior full stack engineers / CTO consultants / data scientists. We value engineers who are strong technically as well as great communicators. We work with lots of freelancers who appreciate the steady, interesting work.

Our typical stack is TypeScript, React, Postgres, and AWS although it will vary project to project.

If you enjoy moving fast, working with great engineers, and building something from the ground up, you’ll fit right in.

If interested, reach out directly to me at vance [at] blackbird.us with your resume, link to your LinkedIn, and a small blurb on why you think you'd be a good fit. Must be based in the USA and have 5+ years of engineering experience.

comment_text.value:
ArtCraft | Senior Engineers | SF (Onsite) / Atlanta (Onsite) | $150-$250k + Equity | https://getartcraft.com

Those fucking rent-seeking hyperscalers took the internet away from you, and we’re going to give it back to you and to everyone.

Web 1.0 was great - we had IRC, file sharing, third party chat clients. There were personal websites, forums. Flash was a format kids could use. Everything supported embedding and uploading. Websites actually had APIs and RSS. File sharing, FTP, MP3s, discs, owned media.

Broadband brought our parents and grandparents online, but the shift to the non-technical majority created an opportunity to grossly oversimplify everything. Everything dumbed down into a pre-packaged product. Startups began turning their offerings into walled gardens. Platforms took precedence over protocols. APIs and access and data export went away. And then the rent-seeking began. The era of ownership ended.

Corporate Memphis. Jesus Christ.

We’ve rallied a massive community to build MIT/Apache-licensed alternatives to Adobe, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Autodesk, SolidWorks, Slack, Discord, Unreal Engine, OpenRouter, RunPod, and more. The goal is full feature parity, with code anyone can own, inspect, modify, and build on.

We’re digesting second-class apps and platforms into first-class applications, libraries, and APIs with full MCP support. We’re distilling out the good parts, and we’re building the connective tissue that draws them together.

100% of the internet is going to be open source soon, and we’re going to force it open. Loudly.

We have eight figures in run rate revenue, over 20M app downloads and growing. Our community is the best part, and it’s energetic like a wildfire. Everyone resonates with our mission.

We’re missionaries, not mercenaries. We are going to slay the incumbents by being better. Our motto is Google’s old motto - “Don't be evil (tm)”.

We’re a tiny team looking for strong engineers to own major parts of the product: desktop apps, lots of completely open source backend infrastructure, agent workflows, agentic app factories. Stack: Rust, a sprinkle of TypeScript/React, egui, Tauri, MySQL/Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes. Lots and lots of Rust. We’re systems engineers by trade, but we like to vibe code Rust. Did I say Rust? Rust. Rust Rust Rust. Maybe that's a filter.

You have to be self-directed and independent. If you want to open source Salesforce with half your time, do it! If you want to work on Solidworks 3D printing applications, great! Writing music apps and DAWs? Go for it! Custom Discord/Slack clients for our custom, completely open source chat API and platform? Hell yeah. Our organization is flat, and we're going to go after everybody and everything.

Everything you build here will be open source. We have no private repos.

We can reclaim the internet. That’s our mission.

Want to know more about us? Look up “Adobe ArtCraft” on YouTube / TikTok / your platform of choice.

If this resonates with you, email hn@storyteller.ai with your Github, a little about yourself and something you’ve built. Write the sentence, “don’t take my RAM, Sam!” so we know you’re one of the good guys.

eventfirst | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Berlin, Germany | REMOTE (CET) | Full-time | eventfirst.com

We are applying AI to organize corporate events.

We are looking for a senior engineer with at least ten years of full stack experience, a strong focus on product and UX, and some experience building an AI chat based product.

Our tech stack is Typescript, React, Next.js and Tailwind. On the backend we use Drizzle with Neon, deployed and monitored via Vercel. Agents and background jobs are executed via trigger.dev. This gives us a killer DX because the entire tech stack supports preview branching. This allows coding agents to work in parallel on different features and verify their work independently very close to what will run in prod. CI is fast (2-3 min) and coverage is good enough to deploy to prod many times per day.

Strello Health | Toronto (hybrid in-person/virtual)

Clinic Sales & Onboarding Lead | https://strello.health

Strello is an AI front desk for Canadian medical clinics. It answers calls, books and moves appointments, and works directly inside the clinic's EMR. We're physician-founded (I'm a practising rheumatologist), and the product came out of our own front-desk turnover problems.

What you'll do: - Own inbound leads and respond fast. Screen for fit first: are they on an EMR we integrate with, and is Strello the right answer for their phones?

- Run discovery and demo calls with physicians and clinic managers, then quote, close, send contracts and payment links, and keep the CRM current.

- Lead onboarding: workflow meetings with clinic staff, phone and EMR access, and launch coordination with our engineers.

- Stay the go-to contact after launch, and bring what you hear back to the product team.

You might be a fit if you've worked in sales, or clinic operations (MOA, coordinator, manager), or healthcare SaaS account management, or customer success.

You should be comfortable on the phone and on video with physicians, organized enough to run many clinics in parallel, and happy to help write the playbook at an early-stage company.

Apply: reza@strello.health with a few lines on the clinics or customers you've worked with.

Paradromics | Embedded Software Engineer | Austin, TX or Oakland, CA | Onsite | Full-time

Paradromics is building a high bandwidth brain-machine interface for clinical use. The implant we built is restoring function to patients by streaming out neural data from specific brain regions in real time, which we convert to e.g. speech using machine learning. Check out our recent article in the NYT: https://archive.ph/C6CRb .

We're looking for help in further developing and hardening our embedded Linux components, which work in tandem with FPGAs and our custom ASICs to read out neural data. Some of the ongoing efforts are: HIL testing on real devices, integrating new sensor ASICs, maintaining our Yocto build system, exploratory work on prototypes, improving our clinical UX, and improving the core code that receives and massages data. The code is largely written in Rust with a little Typescript, (and bash, and bitbake recipes, etc).

You'll be expected to have experience constructing reliable and understandable software in Linux, and some level of experience in building and interacting with embedded hardware. Rust experience is ideal but not necessary. We're not looking for a specific number of YoE, but for motivated and hungry engineers who want to push the frontier of brain-machine interfaces.

To apply visit https://paradromicsinc.applytojob.com/apply/u5hXN4N9ID/Embed... or email your resume and a little about yourself to me, ehuber@paradromics.com . I'll be glad to hear from you!

Memorang | Product Engineers + Technical Project Manager | Full-Time | Los Angeles (or US remote for exceptional hires)

Memorang is an "AI stack for education" that helps organizations build, launch, and monetize AI-powered learning and assessment products. Think Vercel plus Shopify for EdTech. We currently operate on an enterprise model, serving as the AI technology and commercial partner behind new product lines for organizations like ETS, McGraw-Hill, Pearson, and the ACT.

We’re hiring for two roles:

Product Engineers Own features from the first rough idea to production. You’ll work across AI workflows, backend systems, and user interfaces, making product decisions along the way. We’re looking for engineers who ask good questions, care about the details users notice, and can turn an ambiguous problem into something useful and shipped.

Stack: TypeScript, React/Next.js, React Native, Node.js, AWS Lambda, Postgres, and Neo4j.

Technical Project Manager Turn complex work into clear plans and keep delivery moving. You’ll coordinate across engineering, design, and customer needs, surface dependencies early, resolve blockers, and keep owners and timelines clear as priorities change.

Ideal background: an engineer who moved into project management, with startup experience and enough technical depth to discuss APIs, architecture, and AI workflows with the people building them.

Why join? A small team, meaningful ownership, and products used by millions. You’ll help shape what we build and how we work, with a short path from an idea to seeing it in users’ hands.

Remote-first, async-friendly, with health and wellness stipends, home-office support, and paid time off.

Apply: Email careers@memorang.com with your CV, a few sentences about what interests you, and something you’re proud to have built or delivered.

VIVA Finance | Atlanta, GA (In Person)| Front-End + Mobile Developer

VIVA is a Fintech Startup based in Atlanta, GA with the mission to build a more inclusive financial system. VIVA offers unsecured personal loans to customers who have traditionally been excluded and taken advantage of by the legacy financial institutions. The VIVA difference is to underwrite heavily on employment history and set up repayments through voluntary direct deposit payments from the borrower's paycheck. Our interest rates are less than 1/3 of the rates our customers are able to get from other financing options.

We are a VC backed company and have been in business for 7 years. We have been profitable since mid 2024. We are hiring an additional frontend engineer to support our increasing customer volume, support new products we plan to launch to diversify our revenue streams, and bring our mobile app to feature parity with the web. You will join our engineering team of 14 and work in a dynamic environment where you are frequently writing net new code to support business objectives.

Our tech stack for the front-end is fully hosted on AWS. The web app is in React and we are building a mobile app with React Native, but experience with this specific stack is not necessary for talented candidates. We are looking for candidates who can come in office 4 days a week to our office on the Atlanta Beltline (next to Krog Street Market). VIVA does not provide visa sponsorship, so please have authorization to work in the USA.

Send an introduction to our hiring manger (alexa@viva-finance.com) with a resume and we will be in touch!

Jump | Founding Engineers (Software/AI, Manufacturing) + all roles | Miami, FL | REMOTE (US) until Jan 2027, then ONSITE | Full-time | $140K–$160K + equity | No visa sponsorship | https://jumpscientific.com/careers

Ethan here, founder of Jump.

Machine shops lose jobs because quoting is slow. A part comes in, someone has to read the drawing, figure out how to make it, and price it, and that can take hours. Many shops also can't put customer drawings in the cloud (ITAR, export control, or just customers who say no).

We're building Jump Quote: AI that reads a shop's drawings and drafts quotes in minutes, running on the shop's own computer. We're starting with a small group of founding CNC shops. Long term, we want anyone to be able to make anything, anywhere.

We're hiring founding engineers first (software/AI and manufacturing), but every role is open. If you're exceptional at something a startup needs, apply.

We care about kindness, honesty, ambition and intelligence. We don't care where you went to school or who you've worked for. We care that you have a winning mindset and can learn and ship fast.

How it works: we start now, remote within the US. In January 2027 we're together in person in Miami, and that's when the $140K–$160K + equity package starts. You need to be authorized to work in the US for at least the next 3 years; we can't sponsor visas.

Apply (10 short questions): https://jumpscientific.com/careers

I read every application myself. Happy to answer questions in this thread.

Mozilla | Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Browser (New Products) | REMOTE (US or Canada) | Full-time

Mozilla's New Products group is a small team building new things on top of browser engine technology. We're hiring a hands-on, senior IC to run experiments inside browser engine internals and find out which ideas actually hold up.

What you'd do: design and build experiments in engine subsystems (DOM, layout, accessibility, JS runtime, networking), prototype features that let programs interact with web pages reliably, and measure everything. That means repeatable benchmarks, profiling overhead, and writing up the experiments that didn't work too. Compensation: base salary scaled to experience, meaningful early-stage equity, and 100% covered health insurance for you and your immediate family.

We are a highly senior team. Most of us have been founders or on early founding teams, so we operate with high ownership. The PM team is small, and everyone on it has a real, current AI-assisted practice: we design, prototype, and build with AI tools every day.

The role: You'll spend your time with customers and in the product. You'll run discovery with CISOs and IT teams, guide pilots, and turn what you learn into clear direction for engineering. You'll also build: design and prototype with AI tools, make your own tools for research, analysis, and reporting, and open PRs against the product when that's the fastest way to get something done. On a small team, expect to take on whatever the company needs.

What we're looking for:

- 10+ years building B2B software, at least 5 of them as a PM

- Customer discovery and pilots you ran yourself, ideally with enterprise IT or security teams

- Things you built yourself that you can walk us through: prototypes, internal tools, or merged PRs

- Crisp, clear communication, written and spoken, with customers, engineers, and executives

- Security experience is a plus

Paramark | Software Engineer (L4) | San Francisco HYBRID (3 days/wk) or REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $199K–$249K + equity

Paramark helps Marketing teams optimize spend across all of their channels and programs. There are proven scientific ways to do this, but they are poorly understood and practiced by only a tiny fraction of teams. Our product ingests data from all of our customers' marketing channels and uses it to train open-source ML models for both measurement and experimentation. This makes it possible for any marketer to use these methods.

In this domain, it's hard to figure out what to build, and it's even harder to be both accurate and simple. You'll be joining a small team -- we have four product engineers. That means owning systems end to end and having real influence over what gets built. Your typical project will start with a high level goal, and you will figure out the rest.

Founded 2023, ~16 people, $8M from Greylock, cash-flow positive. Reasonable working hours: when the Mercury News covered the return of 996 culture, we were the counterexample. "We don't think early stage startup life requires 18-hour days, or even 12-hour days." https://www.mercurynews.com/2025/08/25/silicon-valley-startu.... 4 weeks PTO plus federal holidays, medical/dental/vision (100% of employee premiums, 50% for family).

Looking for 8+ years, full-stack. Some exposure to statistics, experimentation, or A/B testing helps.

Stack: TypeScript, React, Python, Postgres. Google Cloud, Kubernetes, FastAPI, taskiq.

Process: intro call; technical phone screen; one-day onsite in SF (travel covered for remote candidates)

In-person: https://paramark.com/careers/software-engineer-l4

Remote: https://paramark.com/careers/software-engineer-l4-remote

I'm the CTO and I read every application myself. Happy to answer questions in this thread.

Stratirus (a Tennetech company) | AI Developer + Linux Admin (junior to mid) | REMOTE (US only, Central Time hours) | US work authorization required, no sponsorship | Full-time or part-time, contract or hire | $65k to $100k | No agencies

Our optional take-home is a broken Ubuntu server: a service that won't stay up, a nightly report that hasn't gone out in days, and a disk that keeps filling. Fix it, write a script that heals a fresh box, and build a small read-only MCP tool so an AI agent can check on it. 60 to 90 minutes, unpaid, no LeetCode. If that sounds like fun, read on.

We're a small and growing AI and Microsoft 365 consultancy in Franklin, TN. We build AI agents and automation for small and mid-sized businesses, and harden and run the systems underneath: Microsoft 365 tenants, SharePoint, and Linux boxes. We're AI-agnostic and use what fits the client, mostly Claude Code, the Microsoft 365 stack with Copilot and Copilot Studio, Gemini and Gemini Studio, and Oracle OBI. The role is about 60% agent development (MCP servers, Claude Code, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Gemini) and 40% Ubuntu administration (systemd, Docker, patching, backups, monitoring). PeopleSoft experience is a plus. You'll work directly with clients, so explaining things clearly to a small-business owner matters as much as the code. Early-career and career-switchers welcome.

We expect you to use AI every day. What we hire for is knowing when it's wrong, so one of our three application questions asks about a time it fooled you.

To apply, email your resume to hiring@stratirus.com with short answers to: a time a client or boss made an unreasonable demand and how you handled it; a time an AI confidently gave you a wrong answer you followed, and how you caught it; and something you've built with AI that you still use. Work samples get strong preference. We read every application ourselves and reply to everyone, so please write your answers yourself.

Process: email application, a 45-minute video call where you walk us through something you've built, then a conversation about the role.

Remote within the US only, Central Time business hours. Must be legally authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship, now or in the future. No recruiters or agencies, please.

https://github.com/Stratirus/ops-agent-challenge

Questions: hiring@stratirus.com

humans& | Product Engineer (Member of Technical Staff) | San Francisco | ONSITE | Full-time

humans& is a human-centric frontier AI lab. Our view is that AI should help people work together, so it has to understand people and the relationships between them, not just tasks.

Last month we launched Boba (https://boba.app), an assistant you can text one-on-one or add to a group chat. It runs on Ampersand, our first model, trained with RL over millions of simulated days with thousands of simulated people. Boba keeps track of your goals for weeks or months, sets up reminders and calendar invites, uses email and searches the web. In a group chat it reads social context and decides when to speak up and when to stay quiet. Early users have sent it more than a million messages.

Looking for product engineers who have done exceptional work on how humans and computers interact. You’ll build the product side of this: new interaction patterns for an AI that lives in group chats, remembers people and acts for them.

The founding team comes from xAI, Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Stanford and MIT. Our investors include NVIDIA, GV and SV Angel.

Apply: https://humansand.ai/

Cologne, Germany | UMH | Product Engineer | Full-time | 70k - 100k EUR | ONSITE (part remote)

Hi, Alex and Jeremy here from UMH.

8 years ago, Jeremy was absolutely frustrated with the status quo of data infrastructure in manufacturing. Companies paid millions per year for "shitty 90s software" and are still doing that today, when there is much better software out there for open-source. So we decided that we can do this better, first founded a System Integrator, realized most of the tasks in setting up and maintaining a data infrastructure can be standardized, and decided to found the currently VC-backed UMH, which is built on open source software and is open source itself.

What we're actually building: We build and scale a real-time data platform that runs hundreds of Benthos pipelines inside a single Docker container (UMH Core), processing millions of industrial messages that control actual production processes.

Plus a local-first user interface (Management Console) where both non-technical factory workers and power-users/developers can work together. And yes, we care about UI in enterprise/industrial software.

https://www.umh.app/careers/product-engineer-f-m-d-70-100k-e...

Juro | AI Engineer (Agentic team) | London, UK | REMOTE (UK) | Full-time | £115k + equity

Juro is an AI contract automation platform used by in-house legal and business teams. Our Agentic team builds Operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro: it answers questions and takes action on legal data. You'd build the tools that let it act across the product, own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) and put evals around what you ship, together with our QA team.

Stack: TypeScript/Node.js, MongoDB, pgvector, AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, Mastra, some React. Engineers pick their own AI tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor...) and we pay for the usage.

We're looking for programmers first who now build with LLMs, and who have shipped something people use. Years of ML matter less to us than what you've built. We apply models, we don't train them.

Process: 30-min intro call, interview with the hiring manager, a build review where you walk us through something you've built, and a short chat with our CTO. We reply to every applicant.

You'll work from the UK. For exceptional candidates we can sponsor a UK Skilled Worker visa, whether you're relocating or already in the UK. If you need sponsorship, say so in your application.

Apply: https://juro.notion.site/aie

Why: Four months ago Mastra was a very popular open-source agent framework with very little monetization. Then we launched our platform, and now we're closing a couple of deals a week. MONUMENTAL | https://www.monumental.co/ | Amsterdam, The Netherlands | Full Time | Onsite

We make robots that autonomously construct buildings, starting with bricklaying.

There's a lot of vapourware in robotics, but we're deploying robots across multiple concurrent sites today - and generating revenue. In the last couple of months, our robots have built affordable social housing, health care living units, canal walls in the historic city centre of Amsterdam, and a youth sports centre. Help us to build things that matter in the long run.

We're looking for experienced software engineers for many roles. You can help us solve problems like:

- Data sync and analytics queries across a fleet of robots (that can be offline for hours at a time)

- Modelling buildings in code and finding the right UI for operators to edit them

- Designing systems for robots to drive safely and fully autonomously around a building site

Check out the progress we've already made on Atrium, our operating system for robotics: https://www.monumental.co/atrium

We're rapidly scaling up operations - we're already hiring operators in the UK too - and we need experienced engineers who can build the systems that manage all of that complexity. If you think that 'full-stack' could reasonably mean debugging firmware, mixing buckets of mortar _and_ writing React components, we are looking for you. Robotics experience not required!

Take a look inside our software stack: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eh9BfQoKCy0

https://www.monumental.co/jobs

Tandem Health | Engineers, Designers, PMs | On-site in Stockholm, Sweden | Full time

At Tandem Health we're building the AI-native operating system for clinics, so clinicians can focus on care rather than administration. We're building, launching and iterating quickly, and already support more than 10,000 care organisations across 14 European markets, including most of the NHS. We recently raised a $100M Series B to go further, faster.

ORFF Maestra | Prototype Developer; Technical Product Lead | REMOTE (US only) | Contract, part-time | https://orffmaestra.com

We're preparing a U.S. Department of Education SBIR Phase IA proposal to build an assessment reasoning platform for school speech-language pathologists. It implements TTL-MSM, a fully specified decision framework for one of the hardest calls in school eligibility evaluations: whether a student's communication profile reflects a disorder or a difference. Clinicians code each source of evidence, and a fixed rule combines them. The rules are written; the software isn't. The research lead is at Baylor University.

Prototype Developer ($70–95/hr): build a browser-based web app from a written spec, with privacy designed in from the start so it's ready for FERPA-protected student data later. About 15–20 hrs/week for nine months if funded.

Technical Product Lead ($75–100/hr): the bridge between the clinical spec and the engineering. Scope the prototype, turn the spec into requirements, and keep the build on schedule. About 5–8 hrs/week for nine months if funded.

Pre-award scoping (10–15 hrs for the developer, 5–10 for the lead) is unpaid, and funded work is contingent on award. U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

Apply (structured application, about 30 minutes; replies within five business days):

https://orffmaestra.com/developer

https://orffmaestra.com/technical-lead

CoreWeave | Senior Specialist Field Engineers (Kubernetes, Security, Storage, Compute Infrastructure) | Full-time | Hybrid, 3 days/week in office: San Francisco CA, Sunnyvale CA, or Bellevue WA | $182k-$275k base + bonus + equity

I run the US West Specialist Field Engineering team at CoreWeave. We work hand in hand with the labs pushing the boundaries of AI, on some of the largest GPU Kubernetes clusters in the world. Specialist Field Engineers own the technical side of the customer relationship: architecture, proofs of concept, and the hard debugging nobody else can do. What you learn in the field feeds straight back into the product.

Must live near one of the cities above. This is a hybrid role, and we do not offer relocation.

Must have deep experience in these areas. It's in the title. The work we do goes exceptionally deep, and we need people who are already experts in one of these areas.

* Kubernetes [ https://grnh.se/7j1kydde6us ] You've written a production k8s operator, in go or rust. Bonus: GPU scheduling (device plugins, topology, MIG, RDMA), control plane scaling at thousands of nodes, Slurm, CNCF contributions.

* Security [ https://grnh.se/jxbek1o66us ] You've secured large-scale infrastructure and can trace an identity or isolation problem from the IdP, through the kernel and network, into Kubernetes. Bonus: threat modeling against SOC 2/FedRAMP, confidential computing and attestation, Falco/Tetragon, DPU/GPU/secure boot.

* Storage [ https://grnh.se/137kuvyv6us ] You've built or run a parallel filesystem (VAST, WEKA, Lustre) at scale, and can explain in detail how S3 works under the hood. Bonus: NFS-over-TCP debugging at scale, checkpointing for AI training, CSI drivers, kernel NFS/Lustre/Ceph contributions.

* Compute Infrastructure [ https://grnh.se/q3hmrcf56us ] You've brought up and validated large GPU clusters on GB200/GB300-class hardware, from InfiniBand/RoCE fabric validation thorugh PXE boot and NCCL acceptance. Bonus: firmware/BMC/BIOS, bare metal, Kubernetes, or Slurm.

If you're local and that's you, apply through the links above (they route to me) and mention HN.

MixRank (YC S11) | Software Engineers | 100% Remote (Global) | Full-Time MixRank processes petabytes of data every month through web crawling. Hundreds of customers use our data products, including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries such as finance, recruiting, sales, marketing, and security. We’re a fully remote company with a global footprint across 20+ countries. We’re growing, profitable, employee-owned, and have no dependence on outside funding. Applicants from all geographies and backgrounds are welcome. We’re looking for passionate individuals for whom programming is not just a job, but something they genuinely love to do. We’re obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our codebase is friendly to new contributors. You’ll have a fully functional development environment within hours through full automation and will be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in under two minutes.Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you’ll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git. We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We run two datacenters with high-performance servers we’ve built ourselves, capable of handling the volumes of data we process. We’ve implemented our own distributed file system, perform full-scale web crawls, and download and run static analysis on the entire universe of published Android APKs and iOS IPAs.

Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. We’re continuously hiring for the positions below; these aren’t singular roles that close once filled. Our philosophy is that the candidate is more important than the position. For each new member of the team, we design a custom role and responsibilities around their interests. Other companies may create a long list of specific requirements with the expectation that you’ll exactly replace someone on the team or fit a role defined by committee. MixRank is more pragmatic: we first get excited about bringing a unique individual onto the team, then figure out the best way to support their specific talents.

Junior Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time

We’re looking for remote junior engineers with 0–3 years of professional software experience and 5+ years of curiosity exploring computers, programming, and technical hobby projects.

This is an open-ended entry role with mentorship and diverse opportunities to work across all areas of our product: databases, distributed systems, infrastructure and tooling, data analysis, machine learning, frontend/backend web development, APIs, data mining, data modeling, and more.

To stand out, please highlight what makes you unique: passion for computing, curiosity and side projects, work ethic, niche research, or anything else that shows how you think and build.

Ideally, you’ve already graduated. But if you still have one or more years left of school, please feel free to apply anyway. If you’re the right fit for the team, we’ll figure out a way to accommodate your schedule.

Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/Fnwsojk-j

Software Engineer - Remote (Global), Full-Time

We’re hiring generalist software engineers to work on web applications, data mining, machine learning/data science, data transformation/ETL, data modeling, database scaling, infrastructure, DevOps, and more. We’ll tailor the role to the subset of areas that best match your interests.

Beneficial experience includes PostgreSQL, Python, Rust, Linux, TypeScript, Nix, frontend/backend web development, and data mining.

Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mixrank/jobs/RXQspen-s

I’m Kiran, Chief of Staff at MixRank, a fully remote data startup building go-to-market intelligence. We’re US-incorporated but hire globally, and we’re bringing on new teammates to join a fast-moving team with real ownership and impact.

We are a funded and backed venture building the regulated base layer for tokenized commodities including the US-regulated trading venue, Mint and benchmarks, bridging institutional commodity markets and on-chain finance. Commodity markets trade tens of trillions a year on infrastructure designed for paper-based trading; we are what comes next. Launching Q1 2027.

Roles currently available:

VP of Engineering: owns the platform end to end, from on-chain contracts (Avalanche) to the trading engine, custody integrations and institutional-grade security and operations. A VP or SVP who still builds and ships, not one who just manages others; you will have a real say in the architecture before we finalize it and will work with leaders in tech and commodities. You must have done this before: delivered a trading venue or institutional token issuance, end to end. $200K to $300K base plus equity depending on experience and location.

Lead Product Manager: works with our partners and customers to ensure the launch product suite is fit for purpose and aligns participant experience across onboarding, trading, collateral and reporting. You must have shipped products in a regulated financial venue, exchange, clearing house or institutional crypto platform, you write the spec yourself, and you have run product through a regulator's questions. $150K to $240K base plus equity.

We hire on written replies and quality of CVs. We read every reply ourselves, so please write yours yourself. Send a short note on what you have built that is closest to the seat, with references, to careers@neo.co and put the role in the subject line. Please mention you came from HN.

United Risk | Early-Career AI Engineers – Full-Stack, Data Science, Infrastructure/DevOps (10 openings) | New York, NY | HYBRID (2 days/week in office) | FULL-TIME | $100K–$120K

United Risk is a global property and casualty insurance underwriting and distribution platform, with practices from surety to aviation to fine art. Our in-house AI team builds the tools that make specialist underwriters quicker and smarter: submission ingestion, underwriting workbenches, risk analysis and back-office automation.

All roles: 0–4 years of experience (internships and co-ops count; new grads and junior engineers welcome), strong Python, working SQL, and something you built that you can show us: GitHub, a deployed app or a portfolio. Each role leans one way, but everyone works across apps, data and infrastructure, and three senior AI engineers review your work. Start dates from December 2026.

Hybrid: in office at Rockefeller Center, NYC; you'll need to live within commuting distance (NY/NJ/CT).

Stack: Python, SQL Server, Azure AI services (incl. Document Intelligence), Claude and OpenAI APIs, self-hosted models on our own GPUs

- Application Development (full-stack): AI apps and agentic workflows underwriters use every day, including LLM document extraction with human review built in. https://jobs.lever.co/auw/9234d6e2-f306-48d9-9cd6-9192d34d88...

- Data Science: pipelines, models and RAG/document Q&A that turn submissions, policies and loss runs into risk insight; a grounding in statistics. https://jobs.lever.co/auw/6f317af6-4362-4dea-accc-e86ec1d102...

- Infrastructure/DevOps: deploy, monitor and secure AI apps on Azure, run models on our own GPU servers, CI/CD and pipelines; Linux and a major cloud. https://jobs.lever.co/auw/515a3498-4257-4e68-91ff-cf82e854f1...

Benefits: Our Benefits Include: - 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees. - 401(k) plan with 100% immediate vesting and a 4% company match. - Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays. - Life, disability, critical illness and accident insurance. - Employee Assistance Program (EAP). - Pre-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for health, dependent care, and commuter-related expenses. - Tuition reimbursement. - Fitness reimbursement and various additional quality-of-life benefits.

Shepherd (Series B) | ONSITE | San Francisco, CA

At Shepherd, we're pursuing the most ambitious technical vision in commercial insurance: fully autonomous underwriting. Shepherd is an AI-native commercial insurance platform transforming how high-hazard industries get covered.

The infrastructure behind the AI boom (data centers, semiconductor fabs, renewable energy assets) has to be built and insured, but traditional carriers weren't built for this speed. We built Shepherd to solve that.

We announced our $42M Series B earlier this year! That brings our total funding to over $60M — led by Intact Private Capital, the investment arm of one of the largest insurers in the world. Intact is not only our lead investor but also a carrier partner, a testament to the confidence the incumbent industry has in what we're building.

We’re looking for product-minded, high ownership engineers to join our team! The Engineering team is HQ’d in SF, but we’re growing in NYC now too!

We’re hiring for 2 Senior SWEs, 1 MLE and 1 AI PM in SF, and 2 Staff SWEs in NYC. Engineers own projects end-to-end so full stack ability is expected.

Check out our open roles here: https://shepherdinsurance.com/careers Our stack includes: Typescript, React, Next.js, GraphQL w/ Apollo, Node.js, Postgres & Redis – If you have experience building AI agents or multi-step reasoning systems, we’d love to hear from you.

* In the form, be sure to mention that you heard about this opportunity via Hacker News. If you want to read more about our team and culture, check out our blog: https://shepherdinsurance.com/blog

University of Cambridge, University of Manchester | PhD in AI / Earth Observation / Environmental Science | ONSITE | UK home fee status only | £30k tax-free annual stipend

Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380, v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949, https://geotessera.org/) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions.

As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD.

Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills.

We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection.

You can find out more here: https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/from-satellite-to-stre... - if you have questions about the project you can contact me, Sadiq Jaffer, at sj514@cam.ac.uk . For questions about the application process you'll want aidecisionscdt@manchester.ac.uk .

Application deadline is Friday 4th of December with a course start date of September 2027.
